name: cybersec-job-scraper
description: Multi-source cybersecurity job & internship scraper, deduplicator, and live tactical dashboard.
conventions: Use async/await for network and I/O operations
Keep database queries parameterized to prevent SQL injection
Use responsive, high-craft cybersecurity HUD design with dark mode
Handle all API errors with graceful JSON responses
Provide clear CLI and script commands in run.sh
architecture_patterns: Asynchronous scraper engine with modular source adapters
SQLite persistence with SHA-256 fingerprint deduplication
Lightweight REST API backend coupled with interactive single-page dashboard
never_do: Never run blocking synchronous requests in the async event loop
Never store plaintext credentials in code (use config.yaml or env vars)
Never hardcode static job counts — always compute live from SQLite database
